fixes.explanation: Gilgal's a fair guess, friend, but it never shows up in this passage. Elisha leads the blinded Arameans to Samaria. (2 Kings 6:19) Picture the walk: a whole army following one man who says, "Follow me…" and they just DO it! Then the LORD opens their eyes, and they look around and find out they're in Samaria. (2 Kings 6:20) I bet that was a SURPRISE!

problems.problem: The explanation still ends with a plain comment about the next scene rather than a Papa Dorin-style finish.
